text:
Alex (AE): Kickoff — AcmeHealth POC. They need data ingestion + redaction + cost guardrails. Timeline: 3 weeks. Who can lead tech and security?
Mira (SE): I'll lead technical onboarding. Need to know upload options: S3 presigned vs SFTP vs VPC peering. Also sample payloads shape.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For success we need 200 representative prompts + gold answers. Proposed criteria: >=88% F1 on entity extraction, 95th pct latency <200ms, stable at 100 rps for 15m.
Priya (Security): They'll require completed security questionnaire and SOC2 attestation. KMS integration + audit logs mandatory. Also: no PHI unless we sign a BAA.
Evan (Infra): Network note: preferred is VPC peering (no public egress). Fallback: presigned S3 uploads. Flag: cross-region egress costs apply if data leaves their region.
Liam (Pricing): For a 3-week POC we can propose $3k credits + capped overage. I need estimated GB transfer and tokens to model an estimate. Streaming vs batch affects run-rate.
Alex (AE): Legal confirmed: AcmeHealth cannot send PHI. We need a redaction checklist and validation before ingest.
Mira (SE): I'll prep a redaction script + guidance. Quick sample usage: 
```bash
python redact.py --input sample.json --output redacted.json --mask-fields 'ssn,phone,email'
```
We can also support in-pipeline transforms but that adds latency.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Include edge-case prompts (truncated inputs, nested entities) in the eval set. We'll run automated evals and share metrics dashboard.
Priya (Security): Retention: they want logs retained 30 days then auto-deleted. Can we support configurable TTL and deletion confirmation?
Evan (Infra): Yes — per-customer retention TTL is supported. We'll attach KMS key ARN and IAM role pattern for presigned uploads so uploads limited to a single prefix.
Alex (AE): Question from customer: can we do streaming (real-time) in the POC?
Mira (SE): Streaming is supported on Hosted API and Dedicated capacity. For Private deployment need extra config; for POC hosted is easiest.
Liam (Pricing): Pricing note: streaming doesn't change token pricing but increases throughput considerations; will include run-rate-based estimate.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Blocker: Acme legal asked for export controls and EU-only data residency. Can we pin POC to eu-west-1?
Evan (Infra): We can pin to eu-west-1 for the trial. Need to verify model variant availability and GPU capacity for that window.
Priya (Security): I'll fill the security questionnaire sections S1-S6 by tomorrow. Please share a security POC contact at Acme (SPOC).
Alex (AE): Action items: (1) Mira: redaction scripts + upload pattern (presigned S3 + VPC peering fallback) due EOD tomorrow. (2) Jordan: 200 prompts + eval harness by Tue. (3) Priya: questionnaire + SOC2 attach by Mon. (4) Evan: confirm eu-west-1 model availability + IAM pattern. (5) Liam: POC cost estimate and credit proposal.
Mira (SE): Quick presigned flow for docs: 
```text
Client -> S3 presigned PUT (limited prefix) -> Redwood fetch into staging bucket -> server-side decrypt with kms:key-arn
```
We will validate redaction client-side before upload.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Acceptance tests I'll add to the harness: 
- entity precision/recall >= 0.88
- 95th pct latency < 200ms
- redaction pass rate 100% on provided sample 500 records

Priya (Security): We also require data deletion confirmation email from Redwood when TTL fires; add to SLA for POC.
Alex (AE): Customer expects a demo in week 3. If any blocker persists we push to week 4. Keep me posted.
Liam (Pricing): I'll cc finance on the cost estimate and include egress scenarios (peering vs cross-region egress).
access-bot: New ticket created ACME-POC-42 — onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/pocs/ACME-POC-42
Mira (SE): I'll attach the redaction script and sample payload layout to ACME-POC-42 once ready.
Alex (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update Acme with these owners and the plan.
